title: A semi outdoor amphitheater similar to red rocks
content: I have a drawing of this place I’ll try and dig up if anyone’s interested in my depiction Approaching the area it feels like a hidden ski resort hiding in the mountains, very rough terrain When you get inside a distant dome shaped amphitheater building it feels like you’re inside a court house Everyone is wearing matching black gowns and some people’s faces are completely blurred but it feels like you still recognize them or completely know there identity even if you can’t see there actual face Feels like a secret library/courthouse/theatre
